description.content: The DTN NOTAM API is an all-encompassing solution to retrieve the most current NOTAM from multiple available feeds to avoid duplicate NOTAMS. Many sources publish NOTAMs and push them to others such as EAD. This causes duplicates which can not be easily filtered due to formatting differences. Currently the NOTAMS are retrieved from the FAA SWIM feed and EAD. Other areas of the world can easily be added applying the same logic.
